principle: Applicability depends on a metric's inputs, its definedness and the test design only -- never on whether the metric 'works'. tests/test_applicability.py shuffles verdicts and asserts the matrix is unchanged.
reference_rows_external: d_cat (BglB distance to catalytic residues; not a panel metric)

status_codes.OK-KNOCKON: AME in the M3 chemistry ladder: measures displacement of the REMAINING catalytic residues (the substituted residue is excluded from its own comparison)
status_codes.OK-PROVISIONAL: interface term in the M3 ladder; promoted or demoted by the rule frozen in PREREG_1B.md, never by the verdict
status_codes.GLOBAL: tested, but the metric has no site input (whole-protein / prediction-global / sequence-only): supplement comparator, or a Part 2 reference row
status_codes.REF: fixed reference row chosen a priori (rules.json reference_rows); a role, not a validity verdict; never counted as a metric under test
status_codes.X-NOINPUT: the metric's input cannot reach the perturbed quantity, or sees it only by arithmetic
status_codes.X-BOOKKEEP: counter, constant, identity-determined quantity, status echo or engine covariate
status_codes.X-UNDEF: undefined by mrx.metrics.definedness for this condition
status_codes.X-UNDEF-COV: defined on fewer than coverage_min_fraction of the test's units, or fewer than coverage_min_units units
status_codes.X-ARM: mode mismatch (M3 metric in an M1 test, or a metric never scored in that mode)
status_codes.X-WITHDRAWN: the test or level is withdrawn (G axis strain, E oxyanion proxy, retired trapping tier, P3 v1, N0 unrelated_protein)
status_codes.X-NOCTRL: the test has no matched X control, so a specificity statement is impossible
status_codes.X-CONFOUND: design-level confound that no configuration removes (PLACER crop coverage)
status_codes.NOT-RUN: eligible in principle but the experiment (or this metric class in it) was not run
status_codes.DUP: duplicate of another test's cell (N0 cat_to_gly == C-Gly rung): read once from the primary

main_set.V1: status in {OK, OK-KNOCKON, OK-PROVISIONAL promoted by 1B} in the primary Part 1 test of the metric's mode (P2K C ladder or P2KE E for M1; the M3 chemistry ladder for M3)
main_set.V2: status OK, coverage >= coverage_min_fraction of units and >= coverage_min_units units (flag 'partial' below partial_below_fraction), in >= 1 test of 2A (P0 zymogen for M1; T2 zymogen for M3) AND >= 1 test of 2B (BglB; plates) of the same mode
main_set.main: V1 and V2; only the _mean aggregator of multi-aggregator families; PLACER stays in the supplement
main_set.reference: fixed list reference_rows, shown as reference rows in Part 2 main tables, never counted as metrics under test
